_what: Sites where a `+` touches a column PostgreSQL returns as a string. Counts may shrink, never grow.
_why_these_are_allowed: Every entry below was read: the operands come from a zod-validated request body (`d.lines`), where they are real JS numbers, or already carry a unary `+`. The detector cannot see that; a human did. Anything NEW is unreviewed and fails the gate.
_how_to_fix: toNumber() from '@zveltio/sdk/extension' (extensions) or lib/numeric.js (engine). Never `Number(x) || 0` — that turns a corrupt value into a confident zero.
